content:
rachel: Quick sync: proposing 'tenant authz slices' to enable sidecarless private endpoints while keeping routing central. Notes before RFC.
rachel: Core idea: lightweight per-tenant process owning certs + token cache + policy, central router forwards authz checks.
ben: How do we avoid explosion of peerings/ENIs?
arjun: Group tenants into peering pools by security tier; offer multitenant slices for low-tier to reduce N.
ben: Cert lifecycle? per-tenant certs will be heavy to rotate at scale.
rachel: Use central CA to mint short-lived leaf certs; managed slices store keys in KMS/HSM, customer-hosted can bring their own and register fingerprint.
arjun: Policy drift risk: add versioned policy ids and require router check include policy_id to ensure consistency.
ben: Failover options? default should be central-authz for availability; SOC2-high tenants opt into fail-closed.
rachel: Operator story: console toggle to disable slice -> flips route to central + revokes slice certs. Single action.
ops-bot: spike branch 'authz-slices-rollout' created and assigned to @arjun.
ben: Spike acceptance: p95 auth overhead <1ms, failover <300ms, peering objects per-AZ <10 for test tenants.
arjun: I'll run the spike and post numbers here; then we can formalize the RFC.
